_doc: 4.0.5 national supercups of World 2026-27 (supercup.py table; internal/handoff/supercups.md). Per country: pack id suffix, names {lang: [long, short]}, date (dd/mm, +1 = the next calendar year, the real 2026-27 edition), from_season (2 = summer: not in the world's first season), legs, level (pens | et_pens), host (neutral), rule [2 or 4 rules: e0 v e1 (and e2 v e3: semi-finals, then the final)] + if_double (one fallback for every rule after the first, or a list per rule: champion | second | third | fourth | cup_winner | cup_finalist), final_date (4 clubs), first_entrants (pack club keys of the real 2026-27 edition: season 1), todo (what is not verified yet).
